title: Effective sample size counted in events
question: With rare binary outcomes, does an effective sample size counted in events (EESS) predict when a MAIC interval fails better than the reported ESS multiplied by the event rate, and in which direction do the two diverge?
design: Anchored-side MAIC on a binary outcome with one prognostic covariate, 108 cells crossing event risk, size and direction of the covariate shift, sample size and treatment effect. 1000 replicates per cell.
